bullets: Led engineering for a cloud-based veterinary practice management platform used daily by clinic staff.
Led architecture and code review across a Vue.js front-end, Laravel back-end, and AWS infrastructure.
Created Figma prototypes and turned direct clinic feedback into product direction.
Reduced AWS costs by over $6,000/month and migrated environments to Docker.
Maintained the platform through end of life after acquisition by Shepherd Veterinary Software.
Shipped 11+ web applications end-to-end, spanning Vue.js front-ends, Node.js and PHP APIs, and CI/CD.
Built admin tools and guided workflows, including a compliance-enforcing policy agreement system.
Integrated single sign-on across systems, including a custom Apereo CAS authentication pass-through.
Built hourly data sync pipelines from network-restricted Oracle sources.
Shipped independently from specs, partnering with designers, developers, HR, and faculty.
